cohort: The study included 68,981 women with singleton live births between January 2017 and October 2021 from maternity centres in Shanghai, China.
finding: The study established an optimal gestational weight gain (GWG) linear equation (opt GWG (kg) = -1.94 x p-BMI (kg/m2) + 51) for pregnant women with a pre-pregnancy BMI below 24 kg/m2, which was associated with the lowest risk of LGA/SGA.
